answer: Diversity threshold: each agent holds an opal badge backed by a $30 bond and needs 12 distinct counterparties per epoch. A sybil farm is hollow: its identities trade only with each other, so the graph exposes its closed ring, freezes it and slashes every bond. Forging 1,000 fakes costs $30,000 in bonds plus $60,000 an epoch in sham trades; one honest agent pays a $30 bond, trades with partners it has, keeps velvet standing and earns $10 an epoch.
